summary: Layer 1B expansion found a narrow set of US-listed direct or near-direct exposures. The highest-fit underfollowed candidate is HealthStream, which maps directly to healthcare workforce learning, credentialing, compliance, clinical development, and student-to-workforce infrastructure. Grand Canyon Education and Covista are direct healthcare-education asset/customer platforms investing in simulation, VR, licensure-linked degrees, and AI certificates. VirTra is a speculative micro-cap shadow candidate because it supplies immersive simulation and certified curriculum for regulated public-safety professions rather than healthcare education specifically.
